record.paper_title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
record.original_question: A unital \(C^*\) -algebra is generated, in fact spanned, by its unitaries. Is there an interesting class of Banach lattice algebras that is generated (or even spanned) as a Banach lattice algebra by its positive invertible norm one elements that have a positive norm one inverse?

evidence.quote: A unital \(C^*\) -algebra is generated, in fact spanned, by its unitaries. Is there an interesting class of Banach lattice algebras that is generated (or even spanned) as a Banach lattice algebra by its positive invertible norm one elements that have a positive norm one inverse?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Recall that a Banach lattice algebra is a real Banach algebra $A$ equipped with a partial order making it a Banach lattice, such that the product of two positive elements is positive and $\|xy\| \le \|x\|\|y\|$. An element $a \in A$ is called positive if $a \ge 0$, and is said to be a positive invertible norm-one element with positive norm-one inverse if $a \ge 0$, $a$ is invertible in $A$, $a^{-1} \ge 0$, and $\|a\| = \|a^{-1}\| = 1$.

It is a classical fact that every unital $C^*$-algebra is the closed linear span of its unitary elements (and hence is generated, as a Banach algebra, by its unitaries). 

Problem: Exhibit an interesting (i.e. non-trivial, naturally arising) class of unital Banach lattice algebras $A$ such that $A$ is generated as a Banach lattice algebra — or even is the closed linear span — by the set
$$\{a \in A : a \ge 0,\ a\text{ invertible},\ a^{-1} \ge 0,\ \|a\| = \|a^{-1}\| = 1\}.$$
Equivalently, identify natural classes of Banach lattice algebras in which these "lattice unitaries" generate (or span) the whole algebra in the Banach-lattice-algebra sense.
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution of this question was located. It appears as a stated open problem in the literature on ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms, and no subsequent work identifying such a class of Banach lattice algebras was found.
